title: 16 March 1969: Paul and Linda McCartney begin their honeymoon
content:
Following their wedding on 12 March, Paul and Linda McCartney began their honeymoon on this day.

They arrived in America on the following day, landing at John F Kennedy Airport in New York City. Their honeymoon lasted two weeks, and included time spent with the Eastman family.

Page last updated: 15 March 2017

Also on this day...

  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Sydney Entertainment Centre, Sydney
  • 1977: Recording: B Side To Seaside by Suzy And The Red Stripes
  • 1973: John Lennon and Ringo Starr watch Last Tango In Paris
  • 1972: Recording: Loup (1st Indian On The Moon) by Wings
  • 1972: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend US Immigration hearing
  • 1971: Paul McCartney attends the 13th Annual Grammy Awards
  • 1971: Recording: Ram by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: Playback: McCartney by Paul McCartney
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, Austria
  • 1964: US single release: Can’t Buy Me Love
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: The Beatles live: City Hall, Sheffield
  • 1963: Radio: Saturday Club
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
